scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w @autoservice/contracts" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/api"
scripts.dev:turbo: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w @autoservice/contracts" "npm run dev:turbo -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/api"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
